items.name: page-lightbox
items.title: Page Lightbox
items.description: PhotoSwipe-backed provider and useLightboxTrigger hook. Every framed image, video and gallery item on a page registers into one shared, swipeable lightbox.

items.name: duo-image
items.title: Duo Image
items.description: Composites a screenshot into an iPhone Duo frame - closed, closed-at-an-angle, closed-landscape, unfolded-landscape or unfolded-portrait - with zoom/focus cropping and click-to-open in the shared lightbox.
items.docs: The frame PNGs are not installed by this command - shadcn inlines file contents as UTF-8 text, which corrupts binary files. Download all five from public/frames/ in the repo and place them at public/frames/ in your project: https://github.com/mattdahlberg/DuoFrameDisplay/tree/main/public/frames

items.name: duo-video
items.title: Duo Video
items.description: Composites a screen recording into an iPhone Duo frame. Lazy-loads on scroll behind a generated poster, then autoplays muted and looping.

items.name: project-image-grid
items.title: Project Image Grid
items.description: Wrapping flex layout for placing several frames side by side.

items.name: large-image
items.title: Large Image
items.description: Full-width figure with an optional caption that joins the same shared lightbox.

items.name: lightbox-video
items.title: Lightbox Video
items.description: Unframed video figure that joins the same shared lightbox, sizing itself to the source's aspect ratio.
